parameters.name: DomainName
parameters.description:
The streaming domain. You can specify a single domain name or multiple domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,).
If this parameter is left empty, the merged data of all live streaming domains is returned by default.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time. The end time must be later than the start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).

parameters.name: Interval
parameters.description:
The time granularity of the queried data. Unit: seconds. Valid values:
- **300** (default)
- **3600**
- **86400**

> - If this parameter is not specified or set to an unsupported value, the default value **300** is used.
- When the time granularity is **300**, the returned bps value is the average number of bits transmitted per second within the 300-second interval.
- When the time granularity is **3600** or **86400**, the returned bps value is the peak value among all 300-second data points within the query period.

parameters.name: IspNameEn
parameters.description: The name of the Internet service provider (ISP) in English. You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to obtain the ISP name.

parameters.name: LocationNameEn
parameters.description: The name of the region in English. You can call the [DescribeCdnRegionAndIsp](~~91077~~) operation to obtain the region name.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC).
